title: Email cap of 6/hour is bypassed by failure events
detail: alerts.ts line 93: failure kinds (capture-stopped-early, capture-failed) skip the emailPerHour check. Probe: 12 about-to-join emails -> 6 sent (cap holds); then 12 distinct-session capture-failed alerts -> 12 more sent, 18 emails in one rolling hour. Failures also push emailLog so they starve later non-failure mail.
fix_direction: Apply a hard ceiling to failures too (e.g. 2x emailPerHour, or collapse over-cap failures into one digest email), and test it.

title: Test-data routing is fail-open when the tag is absent
detail: resolveWorkDb only reroutes on testData===true. A webinar with no tag (classifier config missing/malformed, LKB_AUTOJOIN_TEST_DATA_ROUTING=0, manual recording, unreadable capture-tags file) syncs to the configured MONGO_WORK_DB. lkb itself stays protected by isProtectedWorkDbName, so production lkb is never reached, but a non-career webinar can land in a non-staging work DB. Documented as advisory tags; noted, not a defect against D-165.
fix_direction: Optional: treat missing tag on a webinar-sourced session as unclassified and log loudly at sync time.
note: documented as accepted by the maker (cycle 1)

title: Classifier false positives on single title keyword
detail: minScore 3 with title weight 3 means one keyword decides: "Weekly SOP review" (sop), "Campus security training" (campus) classify as career guidance. "Roadmap to becoming a FDE" scores 0 and is staged as test data. Matched keywords are stored, so it is explainable.
fix_direction: Tune config/career-topics.json (drop sop, require two signals for campus); no code change.

title: Digest once-per-hour guard has no test
detail: Mutation removing `st.digestLog.length > 0 ||` in sendDigestIfDue survives alerts.test.ts. Behaviour verified correct by independent probe (100-failure storm: 10 emails total, one digest per hour). Also pending is truncated to the last 50 on load, so a storm over 50 understates the digest count.
fix_direction: Add a test: two digest-eligible batches within one hour send one digest; file-don't-fix per the round-cap rule.
